title: JSFL element gaps: symbolType, loop, firstFrame, doc.setInstanceAlpha
description:
Add missing JSFL element proxy properties and a document method to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:
1. element.symbolType: getter on makeElementProxy — for SymbolInstance, look up the symbol in state.doc.library.items by symbolId, return the symbolType ('movie clip', 'button', 'graphic'). For non-SymbolInstance elements return 'graphic'.
2. element.loop: getter/setter on makeElementProxy — maps to SymbolInstance.loopMode ('loop', 'play once', 'single frame'). Flash 8 JSFL uses these exact strings. Map: 'loop'→'loop', 'play-once'→'play once', 'single-frame'→'single frame' and reverse.
3. element.firstFrame: getter/setter on makeElementProxy — maps directly to SymbolInstance.firstFrame (0-based number). Readable and writable.
4. doc.setInstanceAlpha(alpha: number): follows the same pattern as setInstanceBrightness/setInstanceTint — iterates selectedIds, calls updateDisplayObject(state.doc, layerId, kfIndex, objId, { colorEffect: { type: 'alpha', alpha: alpha/100 } }) or however colorEffect.alpha is structured in the model. Check how alpha colorEffect is stored in packages/core/src/model/types.ts.
